CLEAN_pending

The command executed successfully: since `clean-pending` starts with "clean", the script wrote the file `clean-pending` (no wait loop for that branch) and printed `DONE_clean-pending`.

CLEAN_partial

The command `python3 hold.py clean-partial` executed successfully and printed `DONE_clean-partial`. Per the script's logic, keys starting with `clean` simply write a marker file (no hold/wait cycle), so it completed immediately.
